name: Uniqkey
description_en:
Uniqkey combines the UniqPass credential manager with UniqAccess administration for business users. The public site describes password and two-factor autofill alongside employee access visibility, groups, policies and audit logs. Its separately promoted Discovery product should not automatically be assumed to be included in every contract.

The practical fit depends on the company’s browsers, local applications, mobile devices and offboarding requirements. European hosting and encryption are vendor statements here, not an independent security or regulatory-compliance assessment.
description_zh:
Uniqkey 将 UniqPass 凭据管理与面向商业用户的 UniqAccess 管理结合。官网说明密码和两步验证填充，以及员工访问可见性、分组、策略和审计日志。另行宣传的 Discovery 产品不能自动视为包含于所有合同。

实际适用性取决于公司的浏览器、本地应用、移动设备及离职要求。欧洲托管和加密属于本文引用的厂商说明，不是独立安全或法规合规评估。

sections.title_zh: 云应用登录需要浏览器扩展
sections.en:
The installation page explicitly requires the browser extension to manage logins and autofill cloud services. A desktop app is optional for filling local applications. The pricing description also places offline password storage on each user’s mobile and describes a trusted-browser period that removes repeated mobile authentication. Exact supported-client combinations were not tested.

A pilot could use a disposable cloud login and a local-app login, then verify each client and the organization’s mobile enrollment process. Test what still works when the phone or network is unavailable. Do not infer a universal browser-only or phone-free workflow from the product’s broad compatibility claims.
sections.zh:
安装页明确要求浏览器扩展才能管理登录及填充云服务，本地应用填充可选桌面应用。价格说明还将离线密码存储置于各用户手机，并描述可信浏览器可在一段时间内免重复手机认证。具体客户端组合未测试。

试点可用可丢弃的云登录和本地应用登录，逐一验证客户端及组织手机登记流程；还应测试手机或网络不可用时的行为。不能根据广泛兼容宣传推断全部流程只需浏览器或完全无需手机。

sections.title_en: Validate work and private data boundaries
sections.title_zh: 验证工作与私人数据边界
sections.en:
The site separates work and private vaults, group sharing, expiration and access restrictions. Administration offers employee/service views, logs and SCIM provisioning. A visibility dashboard is not proof that an administrator can see an employee’s private vault; the vendor explicitly describes that vault as private.

For an onboarding/offboarding check, grant one group a test credential, inspect the event log and remove the member. Then inspect the external application’s existing sessions and rotate the shared credential if required. “One-click removal” marketing does not establish revocation of every external session or password previously observed. Detailed recovery and continuity behavior remain implementation checks.
sections.zh:
官网区分工作与私人保险库、组共享、过期及访问限制，管理端提供员工／服务视图、日志及 SCIM 配置。可见性面板不证明管理员可查看员工私人保险库，厂商明确将后者描述为私人。

入离职检查可给一个组授权测试凭据，查看事件日志并移除成员，再检查外部应用现有会话，必要时轮换共享密码。“一键移除”宣传不能证明全部外部会话或已见密码都失效，详细恢复及连续性行为仍需实施验证。

sections.title_en: One solution still needs a scoped quote
sections.title_zh: 一体方案仍需明确报价范围
sections.en:
The pricing page offers a business quote rather than a public numerical seat rate. It presents password and access management together, with support and integration descriptions. The inclusion table loses its visual markers in static text, so final module, SCIM, service-level and seat entitlements must be confirmed in the quote. No sustained free production tier was established by “try free” calls to action.

The public support homepage exposed template fragments instead of detailed onboarding instructions, and a follow-up navigation read returned403; no bypass was attempted. This record therefore does not claim verified lost-phone recovery, offline revocation, per-platform compatibility or legal software license terms. No account or security test was performed.
sections.zh:
价格页提供商业询价，没有公开数字席位费率；将密码和访问管理一体呈现，并说明支持及集成。纯文本表格丢失视觉勾选，最终模块、SCIM、服务级别及席位权益须在报价确认。“免费试用”入口不能证明存在持续免费生产版。

公开支持首页呈现模板片段，未给出详细入门指引，后续导航读取返回403，未绕过。因此本文不声称已验证丢手机恢复、离线撤权、各平台兼容或法律软件许可，未进行账户或安全测试。
